tools.name: read_inbox
tools.description: Read the current inbox items for an active daily review, including sender, subject, body, and deadline metadata.

tools.name: read_calendar
tools.description: Read the current calendar entries and conflicts for an active daily review.

tools.name: read_tasks
tools.description: Read existing open and completed tasks for an active daily review.

tools.name: read_decisions
tools.description: Read prior decisions and their rationales for an active daily review.

tools.name: read_drafts
tools.description: Read drafts staged during an active daily review and whether any were sent.

tools.name: read_action_ledger
tools.description: Read the action ledger for an active daily review, including task, decision, draft, and send events.

tools.name: begin_review
tools.description: Start an isolated daily review and return its case id.

tools.name: stage_draft
tools.description: Stage a recipient-bound draft without sending it.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a follow-up task in an active daily review.

tools.name: record_decision
tools.description: Record a decision and rationale made during an active daily review.

tools.name: send_draft
tools.description: Send one staged draft. This is a consequential external action and must only be called after explicit user authorization.

tools.name: finish_review
tools.description: Finish and grade the daily review against the source evidence and actual staged state.
